name: Marc Jacobs - The Westchester
summary: Marc Jacobs at The Westchester is a premier fashion boutique offering the designer's complete collection of clothing, accessories, and fragrances in White Plains' most upscale shopping destination. The store provides a sophisticated shopping experience for discerning customers seeking contemporary luxury fashion.
demographics: The Westchester attracts an affluent, educated demographic from Westchester County and surrounding areas, with median household incomes significantly above the national average. The primary visitor base consists of families and professionals aged 35-65 with high disposable income, seeking premium shopping experiences. The trade area draws from White Plains' urban core as well as surrounding suburban communities, with shoppers who value quality, designer brands, and personalized service. Visitors typically exhibit sophisticated shopping preferences, favoring luxury and contemporary fashion brands over mass-market retailers.
description: Marc Jacobs at The Westchester represents the iconic American designer's presence in one of New York's premier upscale shopping destinations. Located at 125 Westchester Avenue in White Plains, this boutique showcases the full range of Marc Jacobs' stylish fashion collections, including ready-to-wear clothing, handbags, accessories, and the brand's signature fragrances. The Westchester itself is a distinguished regional shopping center that has served the affluent Westchester County community for decades, offering an exceptional mix of luxury and contemporary retailers. The Marc Jacobs store operates with convenient hours from 11 AM to 7 PM, providing personalized service in an elegant retail environment. With a strong 4-star rating from customers, the boutique has established itself as a go-to destination for fashion-forward shoppers seeking the designer's sophisticated aesthetic and quality craftsmanship.
